race.description: O'brien Electrical & Plumbing Showcase Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: Strong maiden with plenty of last-start placegetters engaged. One of those is YOTEI (11) who overcame an awkward getaway to be beaten under a length last start over this distance at Ipswich. Progressive three-year-old who should be peaking at the third run back from a spell. FRACUS (9) was in the market and really caught the eye late in the piece to get up for second when lining up for the first time last start at Ipswich. Gets an extra 110m today which is a big help. Looms as a serious threat. FILTHY (1) has switched to the Todd Pollard stable since starting favourite and finishing second on debut over 1000m at Mornington in May. Has not trialled since coming north. Talented and any market confidence should be respected. AURORA BLAZE (12) started favourite on debut over this trip at the Sunshine Coast 19 days ago but found one better. Has a tricky gate to overcome but should be in contention again. COASTAL BOOM (8) resumes. Opened last prep in good style so one to keep safe.
